procedure: EA-NEGONT-02 v0.7 §3.4 D/R/O (working; not frozen). observations: The 527 D deposits of the string pass (351 R, 519 O) reduce by reading to 37 ledgered deposits, 267 grouped as lineage instances, and the rest not admitted with shared reasons. The archive's line on the entity is the Capture Registry and the measures built on it: this is the archive's reception line, and most of its volume is captures of AI Overview at the archive's own addresses.

The composition at this address cites Google's product page and Help page; the Help page is its one marker that resolves directly (support.google.com/websearch/answer/14901683), and #597 cites the same page.

Contested within the archive, and carried as contested: whether the archive's material is excluded as such. #1611 models it as entity-scoped (full depth when named, none when not, a hypothesis); #740 names an entity-level suppression from one day's AI Mode captures; #1612 measures untied admission at 0.26–0.53 of presented cards (not zero) and states it cannot separate organic absence, card rejection and compositional disuse; #1616's wave 1 finds a null (0.59 world, 0.58 archive-adjacent) and reads corpus-specific exclusion as failing its first test.

Carried as distinct levels: #1629 locates failure at the retrieval stage and exonerates composition at one address on its weakest evidence class; #833 defines the composition layer as the whole pipeline that synthesizes from retrieved sources. They do not use the term for the same span.

Carried as change over time, not contradiction: #833's self-capture (June 2026) found the registry described accurately at its own address; #1459 records the same name liquidated in broad-match composition on 13 August 2026.

Where the field and the archive meet: availability, launch, query fan-out, the January 2026 health removals, the EU competition investigation, publishers' traffic and opt-out disputes, Pew's 1% click figure and citation-rank decoupling are in both, the archive's versions graded as attributed or documented. The archive adds what the field does not hold: the trigger as a selection that can return none (patent, attributed), absence as data, admission to composition as distinct from indexing, the presented-card profile by tied and untied address, measured erasure and liquidation at dated addresses, and the instrument's own limits.

Mechanics only: deposits' sentences on Google's purpose, incentives or intent (#64 on the transition's drivers, #149 on stress-testing, #599 on who benefits, #1643 Part Four) are not ledgered; where a deposit disclaims intent (#740, #1634, #1643, #1666) the disclaimer is ledgered as a limit.
